The live configuration sets ReservedConcurrentExecutions=1, but the committed SAM template defines no reserved concurrency for this function, so the limit is live-only drift. Function durations are about 500 ms, so a single concurrent slot cannot absorb the bursts and the excess invocations are throttled. The other functions show no throttling, errors or config drift in the window. Commit 22ac2c5 (OUTPUT_BUCKET set to a non-existent bucket) was reverted and is not reflected in the live OUTPUT_BUCKET, so it is not the cause.
